name: Average Firefox 86
author: Yaseen549
description: Dark teal text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, text color changes to #00ffff, background-color changes from #212121 to #212121, outline-color becomes #00ffff.
html: <input placeholder="Enter your text..." class="input" name="text" type="text">
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Average Firefox 86</title>
<style>
/* Average Firefox 86 by Yaseen549 — https://uiverse.io/Yaseen549/average-firefox-86 */
.input {
  background-color: #212121;
  max-width: 190px;
  height: 40px;
  padding: 10px;

  border: 2px solid white;
  border-radius: 5px;

}

.input:focus {
  color: rgb(0, 255, 255);
  background-color: #212121;
  outline-color: rgb(0, 255, 255);
  box-shadow: -3px -3px 15px rgb(0, 255, 255);
  transition: .1s;
  transition-property: box-shadow;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Enter your text..." class="input" name="text" type="text">

</body>
</html>
